---
title: "Team"
subtitle: "43 people, 25 full-time equivalents"
---

L2IB brings together basic researchers, clinician-scientists and engineers
across Inserm, CNRS, Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1, the ENS de Lyon and the
Hospices Civils de Lyon. Women represent **63 % of the team** and 43 % of its
permanent staff.
